reason: B is more physically grounded and directly testable using exhaust-relevant pollutant conversion and aging metrics; it extends demonstrated M–N stabilization into H2O/NO-containing automotive exhaust, whereas A’s putative nitride–oxide passivation layer may oxidize or block Pt sites and uses partly irrelevant overpotential metrics. B is less novel, but its new operating regime and decisive untreated-control comparison make it the stronger proposal.
